name: documentary_audit
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,sys,subprocess
lane=Path.cwd(); rows=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text()); ids=json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids'];assert set(rows)==set(map(str,ids));bindings=[]
for k in ids:
 raw=Path(f'originals/{k}.jsonl').read_bytes();p=json.loads(Path(f'originals/{k}-provenance.json').read_text());r=json.loads(raw);token=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:\\.|[^"\\])*")',raw).group(1)
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==p['raw_sha256'] and raw.endswith(b'\n')
 assert hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest()==p['token_sha256'] and hashlib.sha256(r['statement'].encode()).hexdigest()==p['decoded_sha256']
 assert rows[str(k)]['literal']==r['statement'];bindings.append(k)
receipts=[]
for p in sorted(Path('.').glob('*.receipt.json')):
 r=json.loads(p.read_text());receipts.append({'file':p.name,'exit':r.get('exit'),'killed':r.get('killed'),'wall_s':r.get('wall_s'),'sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes':r.get('sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes')})
source_inventory=[{'path':str(p),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in sorted(Path('sources').iterdir()) if p.is_file()]
charges=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];budget=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());assert budget['calls_used']==len(charges)==3 and budget['queries_used']==sum(len(x['queries']) for x in charges)==9
for n in [1,2,3]: assert isinstance(json.loads(Path(f'search-response-{n}.json').read_text()),str)
ledger=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]; success=[r for r in ledger if r['event']=='success'];assert len(success)==5
for r in success:assert hashlib.sha256(Path(r['destination']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256']
audit={'raw_token_decoded_bindings':bindings,'receipts_completed_before_this_audit':receipts,'source_inventory':source_inventory,'guard_events':len(ledger),'guard_successes':len(success),'search_budget':budget,'search_responses_complete_storage':True,'qualifications':'No semantic proof/kernel/novelty/independent audit; sampled peaks and native/writer/transient limits apply.'}
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'documentary-audit.json'],input=json.dumps(audit,indent=2),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
print(json.dumps({'twenty_bindings_verified':len(bindings),'completed_receipts':len(receipts),'failed_receipts':[r['file'] for r in receipts if r['exit']!=0],'source_files':len(source_inventory),'GET_successes':5,'search_calls':3,'query_strings':9}))
